about_the_game:
[DLC Supporter Pack Benefits]

We extend our deepest gratitude for your unwavering support toward the game and its development process! By purchasing this exclusive DLC Supporter Pack, you solidify your place in the LUNHOWL universe and enrich your gaming experience with a range of unique privileges:

  • Exclusive Lobby Appearance: Stand out from the other players with a captivating, special blue theme that transforms your game lobby as you prepare for your next tense co-op session with friends. Showcase your style right from the start!

  • All Customizations Unlocked Instantly: No need to wait to expand your collection! This pack grants you immediate and unlimited access to all character costumes and every single accessory in LUNHOWL, giving you the freedom to shape your character exactly as you wish.

  • Exclusive Discord Role: Join our community Discord server to claim your special "DLC Supporter" role. This grants you unique privileges within the community, allows for closer interaction with the developers, and ensures you are among the first to receive information about future content!

We are thankful for your continued support of LUNHOWL. This pack is designed to accompany you on your adventures while simultaneously contributing to the ongoing growth and development of the game.
